test_command: mkdir -p /workspace/test-results; cd /workspace/repo/npm_and_yarn && (bundle exec rspec spec/dependabot/npm_and_yarn/dependency_grapher_spec.rb --format json --out /workspace/test-results/npm.json; true); cd /workspace/repo/python && (bundle exec rspec spec/dependabot/python/dependency_grapher_spec.rb -e "attempts to generate an ephemeral lockfile" -e "when lockfile generation fails" -e "resolves exact versions from the generated lockfile" --format json --out /workspace/test-results/python.json; true); ruby -e "require 'json'; Q=34.chr; ex=[]; ['/workspace/test-results/npm.json','/workspace/test-results/python.json'].each{|f|next unless File.exist?(f); begin; ex.concat(JSON.parse(File.read(f)).fetch('examples',[])); rescue; end}; fails=ex.count{|e|e['status']=='failed'}; puts '<?xml version='+Q+'1.0'+Q+'?>'; puts '<testsuite name='+Q+'rspec'+Q+' tests='+Q+ex.size.to_s+Q+' failures='+Q+fails.to_s+Q+'>'; ex.each{|e|n=e['full_description'].gsub('&','&').gsub(Q,'"').gsub('<','<').gsub('>','>'); st=e['status']=='failed'?'<failure/>':''; puts '<testcase name='+Q+n+Q+'>'+st+'</testcase>'}; puts '</testsuite>'"
